title: Virtual LXP campus integrating AI and XR
summary: Creation of a virtual campus combining educational content, employment support, health- and disability-related services, generative artificial intelligence and XR applications.

paragraphs: The project was developed for a French digital apprenticeship training centre preparing learners for professional qualifications at levels 3 to 6.
The objective was to design an ecosystem combining a web platform, educational tools, support services, generative artificial intelligence and immersive experiences.
As Product Manager, I was responsible for defining the objectives, scope, resources, organisation and roadmap.
I handled requirements gathering and analysis, drafted functional and technical specifications, presented solutions, managed decisions and validated deliverables with the client.
I directly and matrix-managed a multidisciplinary team averaging eleven people while personally contributing to the backend, the generative-AI ecosystem and selected interfaces.

productLeadership.title: Product leadership
productLeadership.description: Definition of the scope, resources, organisation and roadmap, followed by decision management and validation of deliverables.

typescriptBackend.title: TypeScript backend
typescriptBackend.description: Design and development of parts of the backend using TypeScript, Node.js, Express and MongoDB.

architectureAndSecurity.title: Architecture and security
architectureAndSecurity.description: Migration of the backend to TypeScript, Zod validation, redesign of authentication tokens, API access keys and server-side pagination.

generativeAiEcosystem.title: Generative-AI ecosystem
generativeAiEcosystem.description: Design of the architecture and protocols required to use several generative-artificial-intelligence providers.

processingAndAdministration.title: Processing and administration
processingAndAdministration.description: Development of a processing queue, administration interfaces and selected interfaces using React and Tailwind CSS.

xrApplications.title: XR applications
xrApplications.description: Leadership of prompt engineering and coordination of the production of four XR applications integrated into the campus ecosystem.

results: Backend and artificial-intelligence ecosystem operational at the end of the contract.
User interface approximately 80% complete, with three secondary areas still outstanding.
